jobs.occupation: Product Owner for Open Banking in Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Open Banking is reshaping how customers connect with their banks, and Danske Bank is at the centre of that shift. As a Product Owner in the Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe, you will help define how businesses and developers integrate with us through regulatory and premium APIs. You will gain real ownership over a product that sits at the heart of our Forward 28 strategy.

**What You Will Be Doing

**The Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe is a team of around 150 colleagues spread across the Nordics, Lithuania, and India, working to automate and streamline financial interactions between customers, Danske Bank, the financial sector, and authorities. You will work closely with your squad and a wide range of stakeholders to shape an Open Banking platform that is available, scalable, stable, and resilient. The work is genuinely complex, and the decisions you make will shape how the next generation of integrations, whether direct, via third parties, or via AI, come to life.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Translating vision and strategy into clear backlog priorities and roadmaps

• Turning customer needs, business objectives, and technical possibilities into tangible increments

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders across the organisation

• Creating a collaborative and supportive environment where your squad can do their best work

• Identifying opportunities to apply AI to improve both the product and ways of working

**About You

**

• Five or more years of experience in product development, including a leadership dimension

• Ability to make complex topics clear and actionable for different audiences

• Strong interpersonal skills and a natural collaborator

• Commercial mindset with the ability to connect customer needs to business value

• Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations

• Experience working with AI tools or applying AI thinking in practice

Experience from financial services or a regulated industry would be a welcome addition. We are equally interested in candidates who bring a fresh perspective from adjacent sectors.

**What We Offer You

**This position can be located both in Lithuania and Denmark. If the position is located in Lithuania the monthly salary range from 4160 EUR to 6240 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (benefits are only valid for Lithuania the same as the salary ranges) which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE**.

**Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Product Management.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply when you are ready. If you have questions about the role, please reach out to Thorbjørn Tavs Søndergaard, Cluster Lead, API Integration, at thsn@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the mergers with Axioma and Domos, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Market Units are where SimCorp meets its clients – and the commercial engine behind them is what turns strategy into growth. As Head of Global Commercial, you will lead the global commercial organisation that powers our front-line Market Unit teams, including Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing.

Reporting to Oliver Johnson, Chief Revenue Officer, and working as a peer to our regional Managing Directors, you will lead a commercial transformation with a clear top-line focus: making our Market Units more effective, more productive and better equipped to win. The role is based in EMEA – in London, Copenhagen or Frankfurt.

Success in this role means Market Units that spend more of their time with clients, a commercial organisation where AI and data are part of how every team works, and a commercial model that scales with SimCorp’s growth.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Commercial transformation: Define and lead a transformation agenda that makes SimCorp’s Market Units across all regions more efficient, scalable and growth-oriented

• Commercial organisation: Lead and develop Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing, ensuring each function directly supports front-line performance

• Top-line growth: Improve pipeline generation, sales productivity, win rates and deal velocity across the Market Units

• Operating model: Review and optimise the commercial team set-up and operating model, so people, resources and investment are focused on the highest-impact growth opportunities

• AI and data: Embed AI, automation and data-driven insight into commercial processes – from forecasting and territory planning to enablement and marketing execution

• Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partner with regional Managing Directors and Market Unit leaders, and establish a commercial cadence and KPIs that give leadership clear transparency on performance

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• Experience leading a commercial team transformation end-to-end, with measurable improvements in productivity and growth

• Significant experience driving commercial performance and value creation; scaled experience in Financial Services, Private Equity or Software

• Deep knowledge of financial services and the investment management software market, including the buy-side client landscape, market dynamics and competitors

• Senior leadership of commercial functions such as Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and/or Marketing, across multiple regions and cultures

• An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience applying AI, automation and modern go-to-market tooling to commercial teams

• Leadership that builds and inspires high-performing teams, makes difficult decisions with clarity and empathy, and influences senior stakeholders in a matrix organisation

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Michael Paterson, Talent Acquisition Partner, at MLPN@SimCorp.com . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Development Representative — Italian Speaking, South Pod EMEAHelp us create qualified enterprise pipeline that protects the world's factory floors

Start date: January 1, 2027

At Secomea, our Sales Development team plays a critical role in creating and developing new business opportunities across manufacturers, machine builders and industrial organizations.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative for our South Pod, with a focus on Italy, you'll work closely with Territory Managers and the wider commercial team to identify the right accounts, engage relevant stakeholders and develop opportunities into qualified enterprise pipeline.

Your primary focus will be supporting our growth across Italy and the Southern European markets.

This is not simply an appointment-setting role. We want our SDRs to understand the businesses they target, recognize relevant market and customer signals, and have credible conversations with prospects.

You'll use modern sales technology and AI to make research, preparation and personalization more effective—giving you more time to focus on developing business and engaging customers.

What you'll do

• 
Generate qualified pipeline across named enterprise accounts within the Southern Europe territory

• 
Research and prioritize target accounts based on fit, business signals and relevant triggers

• 
Develop outbound, inbound and partner-sourced opportunities

• 
Engage prospects through calls, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels

• 
Build relationships across multiple stakeholders, including OT, Security, Operations, IT and business leaders

• 
Run initial discovery to understand business challenges, priorities, timing and potential opportunities

• 
Work strategically with Territory Managers on target accounts and territory priorities

• 
Collaborate with Partner Managers, Marketing and Pre-Sales to develop opportunities

• 
Create high-quality Sales Accepted Opportunities and ensure a strong handover to the Territory Manager

• 
Use AI and sales technology to support account research, preparation and relevant outreach

• 
Maintain accurate account, activity and opportunity information in Salesforce

What we're looking for

Commercial curiosity

You're interested in understanding how companies operate, what challenges they're facing and where there may be an opportunity to create value.

You don't just ask, "Who can I book a meeting with?" You want to understand why this company, why this person and why now.

Strong communication

You're comfortable starting conversations with new people, whether that's over the phone, email, LinkedIn or in a meeting.

You can communicate clearly, ask good questions and adapt your approach depending on who you're speaking with.

Fluent, professional-level Italian and English, both written and spoken, is required for this role, as you'll be prospecting, conducting discovery and communicating with senior stakeholders across the Italy and Southern European markets.

Dutch language skills are a strong advantage, but not required.

Account-based thinking

You understand—or want to learn—how enterprise sales differs from high-volume prospecting.

You're comfortable researching accounts, identifying multiple relevant stakeholders and developing different ways into an organization rather than relying on a single contact.

Business acumen

You're interested in learning about manufacturing, industrial operations and cybersecurity and can connect technology to business outcomes such as uptime, productivity, service efficiency, risk and compliance.

AI & digital fluency

You're comfortable using modern technology to work smarter.

Experience with generative AI, sales intelligence or prospecting tools is an advantage, but you don't need to be an AI expert. What's more important is curiosity, good judgment and the willingness to learn how these tools can improve your research and sales effectiveness.

Drive and discipline

You're proactive, resilient and comfortable taking ownership of your territory and pipeline.

At the same time, you understand that enterprise sales requires discipline: following up, keeping CRM data accurate, documenting what you've learned and consistently delivering on commitments.

How we measure success

Success in this role is about creating quality pipeline—not simply generating activity.

You'll be measured on areas including:

• 
Qualified opportunities created

• 
Pipeline generated

• 
Qualified meetings booked and held

• 
Quality and conversion of opportunities

• 
Development of target enterprise accounts

• 
Collaboration with Territory Managers and partners

• 
Consistent use of our sales processes and tools

What success looks like at Secomea

Our strongest Enterprise SDRs are account-first, curious and commercially minded.

They research before they reach out. They look for real reasons to engage. They build relationships across an organization rather than relying on one contact. They use technology intelligently, but know that great conversations and human judgment ultimately create opportunities.

Most importantly, they see themselves as business developers—not appointment setters.

If you're excited about developing your enterprise sales career while working at the intersection of industrial technology, cybersecurity and modern sales, we'd like to hear from you.

The Job

We are looking for Warehouse Operators to join AGC Biologics' GMP Warehouse in Søborg. You will become part of our Picking team, which plays a vital role in supporting the production of life-saving medicines.

At AGC Biologics, we work with the purpose of "Bringing purpose to life", and your role will help support the production of life-saving medicines for patients around the world.

At AGC Biologics, you will handle materials and products that are of great value and play a critical role in pharmaceutical production. Therefore, quality, accuracy, and accountability are essential in the daily work.

You can expect an active workday with plenty of walking, structured routines, and close collaboration with colleagues across warehouse and production departments. At the same time, you will become part of an international workplace with employees from many different cultures and nationalities, where positivity, respect, and teamwork are a natural part of everyday life.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Picking and packing materials and goods

• 
Scanning and registering goods in warehouse management systems

• 
Receiving goods from external warehouses and logistics partners

• 
Storing and placing goods in designated warehouse locations

• 
Inventory counting and quality control

• 
Processing inventory transactions and warehouse documentation

• 
Forklift operation and internal transport of materials

• 
Cleaning and maintaining general warehouse order to support GMP requirements

• 
Various ad hoc tasks in the daily operation

What We Offer

• 
A workplace with strong team spirit, a positive atmosphere, and a culture where colleagues support one another

• 
Thorough training in warehouse processes and GMP requirements

• 
The opportunity to work in an international company with an important purpose

• 
Great colleagues who collaborate and succeed together

• 
A canteen scheme as well as access to fruit, coffee, and excellent facilities

• 
Have experience from warehouse operations, preferably around 2 years or more

• 
Thrive in an active and physically demanding work environment

• 
Are comfortable working with warehouse systems, scanners, and documentation

• 
Work in a structured manner and pay attention to quality and details

• 
Are reliable, punctual, and take responsibility for your tasks

• 
Understand the importance of handling products and materials correctly

• 
Have a positive attitude and contribute to strong teamwork

•

Day shift: 07:00 - 15:00 / 08:00 - 16:00

• 
Evening shift: 14:00 - 22:00

The company provides a comprehensive range of commercial and clinical cGMP biologics manufacturing services, from DNA to active pharmaceutical ingredient (API). Join us and help shape PtX (Power-to-X) and BtX (Bio-to-X) projects on a global scale, working with an experienced team on the solutions of the future.

At Blue Power Partners, we are a global consultancy and project development company dedicated to delivering renewable energy solutions that support sustainable change. We work closely with our clients, who include one of the world’s largest fund managers in greenfield renewable energy.

You will join a team of skilled specialists in a role with a wide variety of tasks. The key deliverables are due diligence, feasibility analysis, and initial conceptual design.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading process development, including feasibility studies and pre-FEED, and sharing your process expertise as a technical advisor

• Working with our modeling team on techno-economic optimization by providing technical and economic input

• Taking part in technical classification meetings, exhibit reviews, and negotiations

• Supporting proposals, tender processes, safety assessments, and plant commissioning

• Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects

• Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders

• Managing third-party verification

• Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery

**You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter.

• An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field

• Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

• A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer

• Good collaboration and organizational skills

• Fluent written and spoken English

**At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.

**

• A strong project-management community across product innovation, technology, Product Development and Manufacturing Development.

Lead engineering at a profitable, funded proptech while the team is still small enough to shape.

• Want to set the technical direction for a growing team and still ship code yourself?

• How would you keep a small team shipping to production many times a day, with review and testing that catch problems before customers do, without every decision landing on your desk?

• Where would you draw the line between what an AI agent should suggest and what it can do on a property owner’s behalf?

Sounds like you? Then you might be our next CTO!

A property owner with a portfolio of buildings has a practical question: which repairs belong in next year’s budget, and which can wait?

At Proprty.ai, our models estimate the condition and remaining life of building components and the energy and CO2 effect of improving them. Our software turns those estimates into maintenance plans, and our AI agent, Tily, helps owners analyze their portfolios and take action!

Our product went live in 2024 and is used by customers in Denmark, Norway and Germany. We reached profitability by the end of 2025 and raised DKK 21 million in April 2026, and we are not planning to stop there!

There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance and how engineering is run at Proprty.ai.

Product: TypeScript, React and Next.js on Vercel, with Supabase (PostgreSQL, row-level security, storage).

Data and models: Python and PySpark on Databricks (Azure, EU), Python model services, and LLM features on Azure OpenAI. We also run a customer API and an MCP server.

What you get to shape

The team and the code.

You'll lead our product engineering team, work closely with our data engineers and our Chief Data Science Officer, and keep building core features yourself.

You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself that afternoon. You'll own engineering hiring as the team grows, from deciding which roles we need to choosing the people you want on the team.

How we build and ship.

You’ll own the platform’s architecture and how we test and release. We release to production many times a day. Your job is to keep that pace while making every release reliable and secure.

When an urgent customer request competes with longer-term platform work, you’ll make the call and explain what comes first and why.

Shape what Tily can do next.

Our data scientists build models for building condition, remaining life, cost, and energy across several European markets.

Together with our Chief Data Science Officer, you'll get those models in front of customers, decide what Tily may do on an owner's behalf, and use feedback from property owners, Sales, and Customer Success to choose the next problems to solve.

Change how we use AI ourselves.

Change how we use AI ourselves. Our engineers build with Claude Code and Cursor, AI agents review every pull request in our CI/CD pipeline, and agents take on routine work end to end so the team can ship faster.

We keep looking for new ways AI can raise our pace, and you'll lead that.

We talk a lot (in a good way). When a problem gets tricky, we pull up a chair and pair on it. We like having a laugh while we figure things out.

What you’ll bring?

You've been CTO or head of engineering at a startup or scale-up while the product, the team, and the rules were still taking shape, and you can show what changed because you were there.

You know when to open a pull request yourself, when to let another engineer make the call, and which shortcut will come back to bite you two releases from now.

You bring curiosity about our industry, our customers' problems, and the business acumen to understand how our product delivers business value, so that you can help facilitate features that drive outcomes and make our users' lives easier.

We’re AI-first (the name’s a bit of a giveaway). If you’ve built an agent or shipped an AI feature, we’d love to hear what happened after the demo. What did customers trust it to do, and where did they want the controls back? You’ll get to make those calls with Tily and figure out where AI helps our own engineers ship better software.

The core of what we consider for a candidate

• You’ve led an engineering team, coached developers, and hired people to join it.

• You’re keen to build AI agents that customers can put to work and to explore where AI makes your own team more effective.

• You still build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, and SQL. You can take a feature from technical design through thoughtful user experience to release, and measure what happens when customers get their hands on it.

• Fluent in English

Experience we’d love to hear about

• Taking an engineering team from a startup to a scale-up phase, understanding how and when to mature processes as the team scales, and how that looks different in this new AI era.

• Shipping an AI agent or feature into production. We’re especially curious about what you changed after people started using it.

• How you’ve spoken with customers and industry experts to help ensure we’re on the forefront of solving the right problems in our platform

• Your perspective on the role of a CTO as a thought leader.

• Working with PostgreSQL or Next.js, or building products for real estate or proptech.

Where we work

We spend 4 days a week together in our office near Rådhuspladsen. You’ll need to be based in the Copenhagen area, as we can’t offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.

New to proptech? That’s fine. If you’ve led engineers and still enjoy being one, we’d love to hear from you.

Questions? Reach out to Casper høgh at Csh@ing.dk, who helps us land the right human for the job

Our hiring process

• Intro call with Casper Høgh – We’ll talk about your background, what you want from your next CTO role, and any questions you have about proprty.ai.

• In-person interview – Meet us at our Copenhagen office for a small demo and talk through the team, the decisions you’d own, and how you like to lead while staying hands-on.

• Case interview – Work through an engineering scenario with us. We want to understand what you’d prioritize, which trade-offs you see, and why.

• Board interview - Meet with one of our board members. Get their perspective on our journey and talk them through how you would help us in our next phase of growth.

• Offer – If we both see a fit, we’ll talk through the offer and next steps together.

jobs.occupation: Sales Development Representatives for the Swedish and Finnish Markets, Copenhagen based
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by new business, building relationships and creating measurable results?

At EasyTable, you will become part of an international sales team in Copenhagen, working directly with restaurants across one of Nordic markets.

We are looking for two Sales Development Representatives to join our team: one to develop the Swedish market and one to develop the Finnish market.

Both roles involve creating business opportunities, building relationships with restaurant owners and demonstrating the value EasyTable can bring to their business.

You will take ownership of your own sales activities and drive opportunities forward from first contact to a paying customer.

This is an opportunity to build a career in B2B sales in Copenhagen while working directly with one of the Nordic markets and taking ownership of your own customer pipeline.

The position

We Are Hiring For Two Separate Positions

• Swedish Market: Responsible for growing EasyTable's customer base in Sweden.

• Finnish Market: Responsible for growing EasyTable's customer base in Finland.

Both positions are focused on proactive sales, where you will manage your own pipeline and work towards clear individual targets.

You will be based at our office in Østerbro, Copenhagen, working alongside an international team while taking ownership of developing your assigned market.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Identify and proactively reach out to restaurant owners across your assigned market

• Understand potential customers' businesses, challenges and needs

• Book and conduct online demonstrations of EasyTable

• Present EasyTable's value proposition based on each restaurant's needs

• Follow up consistently and drive opportunities from first contact to agreement

About You

Depending on which market you will be responsible for, you should:

• Speak and write Swedish at a native level (Swedish Market) or Finnish at a native level (Finnish Market)

• Be able to communicate professionally in English

• Enjoy proactive sales and reaching out to new potential customers

• Be confident speaking with customers by phone and in online meetings

• Be good at building trust and relationships

• Take responsibility for your own performance and follow opportunities through

• Be motivated by targets and seeing the direct results of your work

• As we are looking for someone to start at the beginning of next month, or as soon as possible thereafter, we ideally expect candidates to already be based in Copenhagen or the surrounding area.

Previous experience with B2B sales is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Motivation, commercial drive and the willingness to learn are important to us.

What can you expect from us?

You will get a role with clear goals, responsibility for your own sales activities and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings.

We Offer

• A fixed salary plus uncapped commission based on your results

• Thorough onboarding in EasyTable, our product and our sales process

• Ongoing coaching and support to develop your sales skills

• An international working environment with colleagues from different backgrounds

• A modern office in Østerbro, Copenhagen

• Option to participate in our attractive company lunch programme

• Friday bars and other social activities

• Free Red Bull, tea and coffee at the office

Working hours

This is a full-time position of 37 hours per week. We offer flexibility in how you structure your working day, and your hours may vary depending on your preferences and the market you work with.

About EasyTable

EasyTable is a restaurant booking platform that helps restaurants manage reservations and create better experiences for their guests. From our Copenhagen office, our international team works with restaurants across Europe.

As a Sales Development Representative, you will play an important role in growing our customer base in your assigned market and introducing more restaurants to EasyTable. You will join a team where sales performance, personal responsibility and development are central, while working in a social and international environment in Copenhagen.

Could this be you?

If you speak and write Swedish or Finnish at a native level, live in or around Copenhagen and are motivated by building a career in B2B sales, we would like to hear from you.

Please specify in your application whether you are interested in the Swedish or Finnish market.

Send your CV and application here or to the email provided under contact information.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact HR & Recruitment Assistant Emilia Bech (Working hours: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday from 9:00 to 14:00).

Highlights

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

Our Current Stack

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

Nice to have

Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

Language

English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

Are you ready to drive finance-critical IT projects at the heart of ALK's journey to SAP S/4HANA — shaping how a global pharmaceutical company runs its finance reporting and analytics?

About ALK

ALK's aspiration is to become the world leader in allergy by helping as many people as possible with allergy to a better life by providing options of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of allergy. In Global IT, we contribute to this aspiration by supporting the organization with modern IT tools and digitalisation technologies, and by delivering world-class support to our many colleagues around the world.

The Role

As a Senior IT Project Manager at ALK, you will lead important finance-related IT initiatives from inception to execution, with a central role in our S/4HANA journey. You are first and foremost a strong project manager and facilitator who can guide the business through change. Your tasks will include:

• Ensuring timely, on-budget project delivery and successful milestone achievement.

• Aligning project outcomes with the strategic vision of the business.

• Coordinating internal and third-party resources effectively.

• Facilitating workshops and supporting the business through the change process.

• Driving finance projects with an emphasis on reporting, analytics and data modelling — including the redesign of our BW setup — alongside the connected changes across the core finance ERP.

• Steering the relationship with the Steering Committee and Project Group towards collaborative success.

Being structured, organized and proactive, you will anticipate issues before they arise and know when to involve the right people at the right time.

This role is based at our headquarters in Hørsholm, Denmark, where you will work closely with the hiring manager and senior finance leadership. As our SAP team is located in Madrid and much of the finance team sits in Kraków, you can expect regular travel to both locations.

What We're Seeking

We are on the lookout for a candidate with:

• A master’s degree in engineering, business or relevant fields.

• Proven experience in IT project management, ideally with finance, reporting or analytics projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills, and the ability to support a business through change.

• A structured, organized and proactive working style.

• Familiarity with SAP, S/4HANA and BW/data modelling — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable operating in this landscape and speaking with the specialists. Having already been part of an S/4HANA journey is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, primarily to Madrid and Kraków.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Familiarity with GxP pharma environments is desirable, but not mandatory.

Why ALK Global IT?

ALK's IT division is a robust team of approximately 150 professionals with IT hubs in Hørsholm, Madrid, Kraków, and with employees throughout our production and sales networks in Germany, France, North America and China. We prioritize professional growth and learning, valuing competency and knowledge exchange over formalities and encouraging a collaborative spirit every day.

Become a part of ALK

ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process.

We operate production sites in Denmark, France, Spain, and the United States, with a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. Our headquarters is located in the scenic DTU Science Park in Hørsholm, Denmark, which will be your primary workplace for this role.

Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

**Join Group Treasury at our headquarters in Faxe

The Group Treasury-team reports directly to Executive Management and works closely with other headquarters functions, subsidiaries, and our Shared Service Centre in Lithuania. The position is based at our headquarters in Faxe.

**A Key Role with Broad Responsibility

****Responsibilities

**As Treasury Manager, you will work across a wide range of treasury disciplines, combining operational execution with strategic analysis. Your responsibilities will include:

• Preparing and maintaining the weekly Group cash flow forecast, including follow-up with subsidiaries to support liquidity planning and working capital initiatives.

• Managing Group cash management activities, including daily optimization of liquidity positions and continuous development of the Group's banking structure.

• Monitoring and reporting financial risks, including foreign exchange, commodity, and interest rate exposures, and providing hedging recommendations in line with the Group Treasury Policy.

• Executing transactions in aluminum, gas, foreign exchange, and interest rate swaps.

• Preparing and reporting the Group's financial items on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.

• Conducting ad hoc analyses related to financial risks, bank debt, performance, and other treasury-related topics.

• Supporting the management of the Group's insurance program.

In addition, you will act as a trusted financial specialist across the organization, supporting colleagues with treasury and finance-related questions. You will also contribute to managing banking relationships, funding activities, and the ongoing development of treasury operations and strategic initiatives.

**Our Culture

**We believe in freedom with responsibility. Our leadership style is built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Team members are empowered to take ownership of their responsibilities while knowing support is always available when needed.

We also value a healthy work-life balance and strive to create an environment where people can perform at their best while maintaining flexibility and well-being.

**Why Join Us?

**This is an exciting career opportunity that will give you direct exposure to Executive Management in a listed company. You will have the opportunity to influence business decisions through insightful analysis, sound financial recommendations, and proactive risk management.

You will join an ambitious organization with a strong market position and a dynamic growth agenda. The role offers significant responsibility, professional challenges, and varied tasks within a highly capable and collaborative team. You will also build a broad network across the organization and benefit from excellent career and development opportunities.

**Your Profile

****We Are Looking For a Candidate Who Brings

**

• A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience within treasury, finance, banking, or a related field.

• A university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a similar discipline (e.g., MSc in Finance, Economics, or equivalent).

• Strong analytical capabilities and a solid understanding of treasury processes and financial instruments.

• A commercial mindset with the ability to translate financial insights into practical business solutions.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**In Addition, You

**

• Are advanced Excel user with a strong interest in financial systems and technology.

• Have experience with treasury management systems; SAP experience is considered an advantage.

• Are fluent in English, written and spoken.

**Personal Qualities

**You enjoy balancing deep analytical work with hands-on operational responsibilities and thrive in a role with broad organizational interaction. You are ambitious, curious, and confident in challenging established ways of working. At the same time, you bring positive energy, resilience, and a collaborative approach to your work.

**Does this sound like you?

**If you are motivated by combining analytical depth with business impact, and you thrive in a collaborative environment where ideas quickly turn into action, then you may be the colleague we're looking for. We look forward to receiving your application.
